track_goals.E: 把 Clued 的 Kernel、Canonical、Authority、Currentness、Runtime、Integration、Distribution 与研发基础设施推进到可验证、可恢复、可向 Product Next 交棒的健康工程基线。
track_goals.P: 把已固定的产品、品牌、Console、Context、Connect 与多轨能力转化为普通用户能够可靠使用、理解并持续继续的产品体验。
track_goals.R: 长期研究 Information、Knowledge、Authority、Currentness、Evidence、Context、Memory、Decision、Action 与 Cross-Agent Continuity 的基础理论，并把阶段成果转化为可测试工程合同。
track_goals.B: 以真实用户价值、交易与共建证据验证 Clued 的商业循环、Pricing、Packaging、Distribution 与 Growth，不用文档完成冒充市场验证。

rules: E-001 keeps first claim on heavy coding-agent capacity unless explicit authority assigns otherwise.
Foundational Research may continue in parallel when it does not consume the same constrained engineering resource.
Product, brand and business design may continue as low-cost parallel work but must not delay E-001.
Parallel eligibility is revoked when two items require the same exclusive environment, mutable dataset, account, authority window, production state or serialized migration boundary.

replan_registry.interpretation: No open Replan Proposal is represented in this bootstrap projection. This is not proof that authoritative Canonical state contains none.

forbidden_actions: Do not infer production, database, deployment, release, secret, budget or canonical-write authority from repository projection files.
Do not infer an Agent may execute an item merely because it appears READY or high priority.
Do not use this repository projection to bypass Resource×Action + selector/scope authorization, Development Grant scope or Owner/Policy gates.
authority_projection.resolution_required: Authenticate against Clued, resolve Binding + Membership + Development Grant + effective Resource×Action, then verify currentness before execution.
